caption: The video showcases a close, slightly angled view of a weathered wooden surface made of horizontal planks separated by dark gaps. A single dark oval hole sits embedded in one of the upper boards, while faded mottled discoloration and damp-looking stains spread across the grain below it. Throughout, the camera drifts very slowly, so the oval hole and the parallel gap lines shift by only a few pixels together as a rigid pattern, indicating a small translation rather than any object moving across the boards. Dappled patches of sunlight brighten and soften over time, especially near the top edge and the upper-left region, where brighter areas of light appear and fade along the upper planks. No people, tools, or moving objects enter the view, and the stains and hole keep constant positions relative to the boards, while the slow drift and shifting light continue.
